Eva Green is reportedly being linked to the role of Bellatrix Lestrange in HBO’s ‘HARRY POTTER’ series.

The casting has not been officially announced by HBO, so this should be treated strictly as a rumor for now. The claim is currently circulating through online scoopers rather than confirmed trade reporting or an official studio announcement. Recent confirmed casting announcements for the series have included characters such as Tom Riddle and Dobby, but Bellatrix has not been officially cast. Until HBO says otherwise, Eva Green remains firmly in speculation territory.

Still, it is easy to understand why Green’s name immediately gets attention whenever Bellatrix comes up. Her performances in Casino Royale, Penny Dreadful and 300: Rise of an Empire have repeatedly leaned into characters who can feel elegant, dangerous and completely unpredictable. Bellatrix requires exactly that kind of presence. The character needs someone who can make devotion to Voldemort feel genuinely terrifying rather than simply theatrical.

Green has also been a recurring fan-casting choice for the role long before this latest rumor began circulating. Recent fan discussions around the HBO adaptation have continued putting her name forward for Bellatrix. That does not make the casting real, but it shows why this particular rumor has caught fire so quickly. There is already an audience that can immediately picture her inside the role.

Whoever eventually takes over Bellatrix will also face an enormous comparison. Helena Bonham Carter transformed the Death Eater into one of the most memorable villains of the original Harry Potter films, giving her an almost gleeful level of cruelty and chaos. HBO’s adaptation will need its own interpretation rather than simply recreating that performance. Eva Green would certainly have the intensity to take the character somewhere different.

For now, there is no official wand in Eva Green’s hand. The rumor is intriguing, the fan-casting history is already there and the role feels remarkably suited to her screen presence, but confirmation has not arrived. If HBO eventually makes this one official, Bellatrix Lestrange may have found an actress capable of making the character terrifying all over again. Until then, this remains one very tempting piece of Hogwarts speculation.

Paul Walker could potentially return as Brian O’Conner in ‘FAST FOREVER’ through AI and unused footage, although no official digital return has been confirmed.

Cody Walker says he has no interest in returning as a physical stand-in for his late brother after previously helping complete Furious 7. He and Caleb Walker stepped in during that film after Paul’s death in 2013, with visual effects and existing footage helping finish Brian’s scenes. Cody believes modern technology means filmmakers would no longer necessarily need either brother to recreate Paul digitally. There are also years of unused footage from previous Fast films that could potentially be used.

The most important condition for Cody is Paul’s daughter, Meadow Walker. He said any decision about bringing Brian back should ultimately come down to what Meadow wants for her father’s legacy. Cody has also said he remains happy with the way Furious 7 handled Brian’s farewell. The character was allowed to leave the action behind and live peacefully with his family rather than being killed off.

That makes any possible return a delicate decision rather than a simple visual-effects challenge. Cody acknowledged that AI and the large archive of Paul Walker footage could technically make a digital appearance possible. At the same time, he has expressed reluctance about revisiting Brian after what he considers a respectful ending. Universal has not officially announced that AI will be used to recreate Paul.

The possibility has become even more significant because Vin Diesel has repeatedly discussed wanting Brian and Dom together again for the franchise finale. Brian remains alive within the Fast & Furious story, meaning the filmmakers would not need to undo the character’s original ending to bring him back. A brief appearance or reunion could theoretically happen without making Brian a full part of the story again. Exactly how that could be handled remains completely unknown.

For now, Paul Walker’s return remains a possibility rather than a confirmed plan. Cody Walker will not reprise his old stand-in role, modern technology could provide another route, and Meadow Walker’s approval would be central to any decision involving her father. After Furious 7 delivered one of the franchise’s most emotional endings, bringing Brian back would carry enormous expectations. If Fast Forever does attempt that reunion, the way it honors Paul Walker will matter just as much as seeing Brian again.

BREAKING: Only 5 DAYS until MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY officially premieres September 17 on Netflix, bringing one of America’s most infamous murder cases into Ryan Murphy’s anthology.

Ella Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden, the Massachusetts woman accused of murdering her father Andrew and stepmother Abby with an axe in 1892 before being acquitted in one of the most sensational trials of the era. More than 130 years later, the case remains surrounded by theories, unanswered questions and the famous rhyme that turned Lizzie into a true crime legend.

The new season also stars Sarah Paulson, Rebecca Hall, Vicky Krieps, Charlie Hunnam, Billie Lourd and Jessica Barden, with the story digging into the Borden household, the murders, Lizzie’s trial and the darker psychology surrounding a woman history could never quite decide was victim, killer or something in between.

Five days left. The house is ready, the trial is waiting, and on September 17 MONSTER finally puts Lizzie Borden under the axe again.

‘STRANGER THINGS’ really let us watch an entire generation grow up right in front of us.

At the beginning, they were just awkward kids trying to survive school, friendships and whatever nightmare Hawkins threw at them next. Everything still felt smaller then, even with monsters hiding in the dark. Their friendships were innocent, messy and completely genuine. None of them knew how much of their childhood was about to be taken away.

Over the years, that innocence slowly disappeared. Secret laboratories, disappearances, supernatural threats and constant loss forced them to grow up much faster than they ever should have. The characters changed because they had no choice. Every season left another mark on them.

That is why seeing the same room and nearly the same poses recreated years later hits so hard. The setting barely changed, but the people sitting inside it completely did. Their faces carry more history now, and even the silence feels heavier. It is nostalgia mixed with the realization that none of them can ever really go back.

What started as a simple childhood friendship eventually became one of the emotional foundations of the entire series. They survived distance, fear and the possibility of losing each other again and again. Hawkins took away so much from them, but it never completely erased the bond that existed before everything went wrong. That connection became one of the few things the Upside Down could not destroy.

Then versus now is not just about how much the actors changed physically. It is about watching childhood turn into memory while the story kept moving forward. Stranger Things gave us years of monsters and chaos, but some of its most powerful moments were always the quiet reminders of who these kids were before Hawkins changed them. That is what makes looking back feel so emotional now.

The wait is almost over for fans of The Way Home. Netflix has officially confirmed that the fourth and final season of the hit Hallmark drama will be available to stream in the US starting October 2026.

After becoming a breakout hit on the platform last year, the story of the Landry women is coming to an emotional conclusion. From Kat’s journey to 1925 to Alice’s high school graduation, there are plenty of mysteries left to solve in Port Haven.

One of the most romantic moments in ‘Enola Holmes 3’ reportedly has a real life inspiration. 

Millie Bobby Brown revealed that the scene where Tewkesbury braids Enola’s hair was inspired by her relationship with her husband, Jake Bongiovi, who regularly braids her hair at night.

Brown brought the personal gesture into the film, turning something simple and meaningful from her own relationship into a sweet moment between Enola and Tewkesbury. It gives the scene an even more personal connection beyond the story itself.

Did you know this romantic scene was inspired by Millie’s real life?

Production is underway for the upcoming Netflix film 'Spy Duo' starring Henry Cavill and Kevin Hart. We have your first look at the duo on set in New Jersey as filming begins.

More snaps: https://www.whats-on-netflix.com/news/spy-duo-henry-cavill-kevin-hart-set-photos/

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY officially releases on Netflix next week on September 17, bringing Ryan Murphy and Ian Brennan’s anthology back with one of America’s most infamous murder cases. 

Ella Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden, the Massachusetts woman accused of killing her father and stepmother with an axe in 1892 before being acquitted at trial. 

Vicky Krieps plays Bridget “Maggie” Sullivan, while Charlie Hunnam returns to the MONSTER franchise as Andrew Borden alongside Rebecca Hall, Billie Lourd and Jessica Barden. 

The new season will explore the repression, cruelty and relationships inside the Borden household while reimagining the events that turned Lizzie into one of the most notorious names in American true crime. 

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY arrives September 17, and Netflix is officially entering its blood red MONSTER era next week.

Millie Bobby Brown has revealed just how hard STRANGER THINGS ending hit her, admitting she spent weeks crying and even fell into what she described as a “slight, slight depression” after saying goodbye to Eleven.

The series had been part of her life for nearly a decade, taking her from childhood into adulthood while the cast and crew around her became like family. Brown said the final day was so emotional that she walked onto set crying and left crying, something she never expected from herself.

After the show ended, she even reached out to several castmates because she suddenly became afraid those relationships might disappear too, asking whether they would still remain close now that STRANGER THINGS was finally over.

For everyone else, STRANGER THINGS was a show we watched for years. For Millie Bobby Brown, it was basically her entire childhood, her first family in Hollywood and the role that changed her life forever. No wonder letting go of Eleven hurt that much.

After years of rumors and delays, Netflix and Blizzard are officially partnering for a Diablo animated series. The project was confirmed during the BlizzCon opening ceremony as part of a renewed push to expand Blizzard's universes.

THE FAMILY STONE sequel is officially happening, with the new movie titled THE FAMILIES STONE and much of the original cast returning more than 20 years later.

Rachel McAdams, Sarah Jessica Parker, Claire Danes, Dermot Mulroney, Craig T. Nelson, Luke Wilson and more are all set to return as the Stone family reunites for another Christmas together.

This time, the family is thrown into chaos when their father unexpectedly reveals he has fallen in love with another woman, forcing everyone to deal with a completely new chapter of grief, change and family drama.

Two decades later, the house is full again, the family is still complicated, and Christmas with the Stones is officially about to get messy all over again.

Benedict spent so long chasing the mystery of the Lady in Silver that he nearly missed the deeper connection forming right in front of him.

At first, the magic lived inside the fantasy. The mask, the mystery and the fleeting encounter made everything feel larger than life. Benedict became attached to the idea of someone he barely knew because the distance allowed him to imagine perfection. That illusion became something almost impossible for reality to compete with.

But the real connection slowly became much harder to ignore. Without the mystery surrounding her, there was warmth, personality and a kind of intimacy that fantasy could never create. Benedict was no longer chasing a beautiful moment frozen in his memory. He was beginning to know the actual person behind it.

That is what makes the story feel so romantic. The fantasy was never meaningless, but it was only the beginning. What mattered more was everything that came after the mask disappeared. The person underneath became more compelling than the dream he had built around her.

There is something beautifully painful about realizing that what you were searching for was already much closer than you understood. Benedict had created an ideal in his mind, but reality slowly offered him something richer. It was messier, warmer and more vulnerable. Most importantly, it was real.

Bridgerton loves a grand romantic fantasy, but this story works because it eventually strips that fantasy away. The fairytale is not simply about finding the mysterious woman at the ball. It is about recognizing that love becomes more powerful once the illusion is gone. Sometimes the dream is beautiful, but the person waiting underneath it is even better.

Happy 29th birthday to Emmy Award nominee Sydney Sweeney, one of the most recognizable young stars working across film and television today. 

Born on September 12, 1997, Sweeney broke through with roles in SHARP OBJECTS and THE HANDMAID’S TALE before EUPHORIA and THE WHITE LOTUS pushed her into another level of recognition. 

Her performances as Cassie Howard in EUPHORIA and Olivia Mossbacher in THE WHITE LOTUS earned her two Primetime Emmy nominations in 2022. 

She has since moved between very different projects including REALITY, IMMACULATE, ANYONE BUT YOU, CHRISTY and THE HOUSEMAID, while continuing to build her career as both an actress and producer. 

At 29, Sydney Sweeney has already built an unusually varied résumé, and she is still only getting started.

GROWN UPS 3 will reportedly premiere in early 2027, with Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade and Rob Schneider finally reuniting more than 13 years after the last movie.

The sequel is already in production in New Jersey, with Salma Hayek, Maria Bello and Maya Rudolph also returning as the original gang comes back for another adventure now that their kids are grown up. Netflix has confirmed filming is underway, while the exact release date is still being kept under wraps.

Kyle Newacheck is directing after HAPPY GILMORE 2, with Sandler and Tim Herlihy writing the movie as the franchise shifts into a new stage of the group’s lives.

The gang is back, the cameras are rolling, and GROWN UPS 3 is reportedly heading our way in 2027. More than a decade later, this reunion is finally happening.

Lady Gaga is officially a mother at the age of 40, welcoming her first child with fiancé Michael Polansky. 

The couple has kept the arrival extremely private, with no public details yet about the baby’s name, sex or exact birth date. 

Gaga and Polansky have been together since 2020 and became engaged in 2024, with the singer repeatedly saying over the years that becoming a mother was one of her biggest dreams. 

The pair were recently spotted in Northern California with their newborn, marking the first public glimpse of Gaga embracing this completely new chapter of her life. 

After years of calling herself “Mother Monster,” Lady Gaga is officially a mother for real.

Mark your calendars for 'The Breadwinner.' The Sony Pictures comedy starring Nate Bargatze, Kumail Nanjiani, and Will Forte is the latest title headed to Netflix as part of the Pay-1 window deal.

Subscribers in the United States and India can expect the film to arrive 120 days after its theatrical debut.

Cressida Cowper might be one of the most dramatic characters in Bridgerton, and honestly, that’s exactly what makes her so entertaining.

From her exaggerated gestures and theatrical mannerisms to those iconic puff-sleeve pink gowns, everything about Cressida’s presence feels deliberately over the top.

She doesn’t simply enter a room. She makes an entrance, as if she’s constantly performing for the entire Ton.

Is Cressida one of the most entertaining characters in ‘Bridgerton’?

Netflix is set to honor the legacy of Matthew Perry with a new three-part documentary series titled 'The One About Matthew Perry.' Arriving on October 27, 2026, the series promises an intimate look at the man behind Chandler Bing, featuring private archives and new interviews with his family and friends.

New look at Seth Rogen and Anna Kendrick in BABIES, Lauren Miller Rogen’s deeply personal new comedy about one of the biggest questions couples eventually have to face.

Rogen and Kendrick play Aaron and Annie, a happily married couple who have never been completely sure whether parenthood is for them. That question suddenly becomes impossible to ignore when their newly separated friend moves into their home with her young daughter, giving them an unexpected front row seat to what raising a child actually looks like.

The story pulls heavily from Lauren Miller Rogen’s real life, including the year a friend and her toddler actually lived with her and Seth Rogen. Issa Rae, Kate Berlant and David Strathairn also star, with the film balancing the baby question alongside friendship, aging parents, grief and the pressure of deciding what your future family should look like.

BABIES premieres September 12 at the Toronto International Film Festival, and instead of asking whether a marriage can survive having children, this one asks something much messier: what if the relationship is perfectly happy and you still have no idea whether you actually want them?

First images from 'NOBODY WANTS THIS' Season 3 have been released.

Starring Kristen Bell, Adam Brody, Justine Lupe, Timothy Simons, Jackie Tohn, Andrew Rannells, Sarah Silverman, Shiloh Bearman, and Sherry Cola. 

Premiering October 22 on Netflix.

Theo James and Kaya Scodelario are back as the hit crime drama launches its new season. The Gentlemen Season 2 generated 6.7 million views during its premiere weekend, keeping the franchise among Netflix's top English-language television titles.
Netflix has officially canceled 'Ransom Canyon' after two seasons. Following a steep 43% viewership drop in Season 2, the Josh Duhamel and Minka Kelly drama won't be returning for Season 3.

Mark your calendars! Netflix has officially confirmed that 'Nobody Wants This' Season 3 will premiere on October 22, 2026. The new 10-episode season sees Kristen Bell and Adam Brody return as Joanne and Noah, who are finally moving in together and ditching the relationship anxiety of previous seasons.

The showrunners are promising a "Champagne" vibe for the new episodes, focusing on the fun and romantic side of the central couple's new life together. However, things are getting complicated for the rest of the family as Sasha and Esther navigate a separation.
